name: Casavatore (Italy)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Casavatore (a lamb on red beneath a yellow chief) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Casavatore, a comune in Campania; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Casavatore arms — lamb on red beneath a yellow chief, crowned, within branches
